During the [[Post–Zsinj campaigns|campaigns]] after the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] '''retook''' the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Emmer]] and the [[Emmer system/Legends|Emmer system]], which Zsinj had absorbed into his [[Zsinj's Empire|empire]] sometime after an earlier [[Battle of Emmer (4 ABY)|New Republic victory]] there.
